sloka: यदीन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान् वा स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशङ्करान् वा ।गमिष्यसि त्वं दश वा दिशो ऽथवा तथापि मे नाद्य गतो विमोक्ष्यसे ।। ६.५९.१३२ ।।।।
transliteration: yadīndravaivasvatabhāskarān vā svayambhuvaiśvānaraśaṅkarān vā ।gamiṣyasi tvaṁ daśa vā diśo 'thavā tathāpi me nādya gato vimokṣyase ।। 6.59.132 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh! king of Rakshasa troop! He, who was struck without support now, even if he were to come now in front, you with your sons and grandsons will be struck to death by him."
